title: Communication settings
description: Selects the plc an application communicates with and, optionally, the gateway used to reach it. One Communication.settings.json lives in each device project.

device.title: Device
device.description: The plc the application connects to.

nodeName.title: Node name
nodeName.description: Name of the target plc node. May be null or omitted when no plc has been selected yet.

gateway.title: Gateway
gateway.description: The gateway that relays the connection to the plc. May be null or omitted when no gateway has been selected yet, but a gateway must be set before the application can go online. When set, 'type' selects the gateway driver.

type.title: Type
type.description: Gateway driver identifier. "CODESYS.GwV3" is the built-in CODESYS 3 gateway.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of the selected gateway. Written by the editor when it saves the file; the online service ignores it and addresses the gateway by 'hostName' and 'port'.

hostName.title: Host name
hostName.description: IP address or host name where the gateway runs. Currently only IPv4 is fully supported.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP port the gateway listens on.

scanInformation.title: Scan information
scanInformation.description: Snapshot of the identity of the plc, taken when it was last identified uniquely - either by selecting it in the device browser or by re-identifying it on connect. Maintained automatically: the device browser writes it on selection and the online service refreshes it after every successful connect. Used to re-identify the plc and to detect that a different device answers under the configured node name. May be omitted or null, in which case the plc is identified by its node name alone.

nodeName.title: Node name
nodeName.description: Node name of the plc at scan time. When this no longer matches 'device.nodeName' the snapshot is stale and is ignored.

lastKnownAddress.title: Last known address
lastKnownAddress.description: Hierarchical CODESYS router address at scan time. A cache for fast reconnection, not a stable identity: the responder is verified before it is used, and the value is refreshed after every successful re-identification.

targetId.title: Target id
targetId.description: Vendor and device id of the plc type, as reported by the plc. Identifies the device type, not the individual device.

targetType.title: Target type
targetType.description: Device type class of the plc, e.g. "Programmable".

targetVendor.title: Target vendor
targetVendor.description: Vendor name reported by the plc.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: Serial number reported by the plc. Optional and not guaranteed to be unique, so it is only compared when both the snapshot and the plc report one.

encryptedCommunication.title: Encrypted communication
encryptedCommunication.description: Encrypted communication capability the plc reported at scan time.
